description:
Think you can't find a spacious family home for under $150,000? Think again!

Trinidad and Elijah are taking you on a tour of three of our most popular family friendly homes, all offering incredible value, functional layouts, and features today's families are looking for. 

🏡 Atmos- Modern design with an open layout and luxury finishes
🏡 Trailblazer- A spacious floor plan with room for the entire family
🏡 Homeland54- One of our #1 layouts with great space, comfort, and value

In this video, you'll get a full walkthrough of each home and lear about the features that make them stand out. 

The big question is.......
If we gave you $150,000 and told you to pick one of these 3 homes, which one are you choosing?

Comment below: Atmos, Trailblazer, or Homeland 54!
☎️ (325) 676-9700
📍 3301 Hickory St., Abilene, TX 79601
